description: This source file implements the methods of the AccessChecker class, which handles permission checks for signal access, read, and write permissions within the Kuksa-Vale project, utilizing JSON permissions data and channel information.

classes.name: AccessChecker
classes.description: Class responsible for checking access permissions for signals based on channel permissions and paths.

methods.name: bool checkSignalAccess(const KuksaChannel & channel,const string & path,const string & requiredPermission)
methods.description: Checks if the specified permission ('r' or 'w') is granted for a given path based on the channel's permissions JSON.

methods.name: bool checkReadAccess(KuksaChannel & channel,const VSSPath & path)
methods.description: Checks read permission for a specified path in the given channel.

methods.name: bool checkWriteAccess(KuksaChannel & channel,const VSSPath & path)
methods.description: Checks write permission for a specified path in the given channel.

methods.name: bool checkPathWriteAccess(KuksaChannel & channel,const json & paths)
methods.description: Checks if all paths in a list have write access; returns false if any path lacks write permission.

ctags.signature: (const KuksaChannel & channel,const string & path,const string & requiredPermission)
